questions.question:
If in the following figure (not to the scale), ∠ACB = 135° and the radius of the circle is 2 sqrt{2} cm, then the length of the chord AB is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1a3fc6716b7eced2b608587806a936433a7a1cd79d8bc81eb5decdcbb07f2512.png]
questions.solution:
**Given:**

∠ACB = 135

Radius of the circle = 2√2 cm

**Formula:**

The sum of the opposite angle of the cycle quadrilateral is 180.

The angle at the center of a circle is twice the angle at the circumference

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/99e4a770b554545e4a534bca5ab369331048e971c0a97939ff3e914204991c4f.png] 

∠ACB + ∠ADB = 180

⇒ 135 + ∠ADB = 180 

⇒ ∠ADB = 180 - 135

⇒ ∠ADB = 45

O is the center of the circle.

∠BOA = 2 ∠BDA

⇒ ∠BOA = 2 × 45

⇒ ∠BOA = 90

OA = OB = 2√2 (radius of the circle)

In right angled triangle BOA

AB² = OB² + OA²

⇒ AB² = (2√2)² + (2√2)²

⇒ AB² = 8 + 8

⇒ AB = √16

∴ AB = 4

questions.question:
In the following figure (not to scale), at the centre O, if the chord AB subtends double the angle that is subtended by chord CD and the angle ∠AEB = 2 ∠AOB, then ∠COD is equal to:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f2aebc7f5621936a6ebf7143d1f8e6ed4e4427cdf6d2d3636638dcdb26d4b5c8.png]
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Chord AB subtends double the angle that is subtended by chord CD. 

∠AEB = 2 ∠AOB,

∠AOB = 2 ∠COD

**Formula:**

Angle made on tangent is perpendicular to radius.

**Calculation:**

∠OBE = ∠OAE = 90°

In AOBE

∠AOB + ∠AEB + ∠OBE + ∠OAE = 360°

⇒ ∠AOB + ∠AEB + 90° + 90° = 360°

⇒ ∠AOB + 2 ∠AOB = 360° - 180°

⇒ 3 ∠AOB = 180°

⇒ ∠AOB = 180°/3

⇒ ∠AOB = 60°

⇒ 2 ∠COD = 60°

⇒ ∠COD = 60°/2

∴ ∠COD = 30°

questions.question: If SecA = frac{sqrt{11}}{3}, then the value of (Cosec² A + Tan² A)/(Sin² A + Cot² A) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

sec A = √11/3

**Formula:**

sec A = 1/cos A

cosec A = 1/sin A

tan A = sin A/cos A

cot A = cos A/sin A

**Calculation:**

(cosec² A + tan² A)/(sin² A + cot² A)

⇒ (frac{1)/(sin²A) + (sin^A)/(cos²A)}{sin²A + (cos²A)/(sin²A)}

⇒ [(cos² A + sin⁴ A)/(sin² A cos² A)]/[(sin⁴ A + cos² A)/(sin² A)]

⇒ 1/cos² A

⇒ sec² A

⇒ (√11/3)²

⇒ 11/9

questions.question: A triangle has sides 25, 39, 34 units. If the area of a square exceeds the area of this triangle by 21 units, then the side of the square is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Sides of triangle are 25, 39 and 34 units.

Area of square is more than that of triangle = 21 units

**Formula:**

Area of triangle = √[s (s – a) (s – b) (s – c)]

s = (a + b + c)/2

Perimeter of the triangle = a + b + c

**Calculation:**

a = 25, b = 39 and c = 34 

S = (25 + 39 + 34)/2

⇒ S = 98/2 = 49 unit

Area of triangle ⇒

⇒ √[49 (49 – 25) (49 – 39) (49 – 34)

⇒ √[49 × 24 × 10 × 15]

⇒ √(7 × 7 × 2 × 2 × 2 × 3 × 2 × 5 × 3 × 5)

⇒ 7 × 2 × 2 × 3 × 5

⇒ 420

Area of square = 420 + 21 = 441

∴ Side of square = √441 = 21 unit

questions.question: A sphere is placed in a cube so that it touches all the faces of the cube. If 'a' is the ratio of the volume of the cube to the volume of the sphere, and 'b' is the ratio of the surface area of the sphere to the surface area of the cube, then the value of ab is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ratio of volume of the cube to that of sphere = a

Ratio of surface area of the sphere to that of cube = b

**Formula:**

Volume of cube = a³

Volume of sphere = (4/3)π × a³

Total surface area of cube = 6a²

Total surface area of sphere = 4πr²

**Given:**

Let side of cube be 3 m, then

Radius of sphere r = 3/2 m 

Volume of cube = 3³ = 27 m³ 

Total surface area of cube = 6 × 3² = 54 m²

Volume of sphere = (4/3) × π × (3/2)³ = (4/3) × π × (27/8) = 9π/2 m³

Total surface area of sphere = 4π × (3/2)² = 4π × (9/4) = 9π m²

According to the question

a = 27/(9π/2)

⇒ a = 6/π

b = 9π/54

⇒ b = π/6

ab = (6/π) × (π/6)

⇒ ab = 1

**Given:**

The given numbers are 24, 45, a, 35, 59, 83, 46, b, 29, 74

Average of 10 numbers when each number is added to its serial number = 55

**Formula:**

Average = Sum of all observations/total number of all observations

**Calculation:**

New numbers are when each number is added to its serial number

(24 + 1), (45 + 2), (a + 3), (35 + 4), (59 + 5), (83 + 6), (46 + 7), (b + 8), (29 + 9), (74 + 10)

According to the question

(24 + 1) + (45 + 2) + (a + 3) + (35 + 4) + (59 + 5) + (83 + 6) + (46 + 7) + (b + 8) + (29 + 9) + (74 + 10) = 55 × 10

⇒ 450 + a + b = 550

⇒ a + b = 550 - 450

⇒ a + b = 100

∴ Average of a and b = 100/2 = 50

questions.solution:

cos A, sin A, cot A are in geometric progression.

**Formula:**

If a, b, c are in GP, then

b² = ac

sec2 A - tan2 A = 1

**Calculation:**

sin² A = cos A cot A

⇒ sin² A = cos A × (cos A/sin A)

⇒ sin² A × sin A = cos² A

⇒ sin³ A = cos² A

Divide by cos³ A

⇒ sin³ A/cos³ A = cos² A/cos³ A

⇒ tan³ A = 1/cos A

⇒ tan³ A = sec A

Square on both sides

⇒ tan⁶ A = sec² A

Now,

tan⁶ A - tan² A

questions.question:
A home decor company produces five different products - Bed sheets, Clocks, Wall hangings, Curtains and Wall stickers. The sales of these five products (in lakh number of packs) during 2018 and 2019 are shown in the following bar-graph.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a8b936a0ed4a2a980cd1b6238739c96e404b4d3a5375f19be13255574a030dd2.png] 

 

Based on the given information, sales have increased by nearly 55% from 2018 to 2019 in the case of:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Sales of Wall stickers in 2018 = 5.01

Sales of Wall stickers in 2019 = 10.19

Sales of Bed sheets in 2018 = 20.15

Sales of Bed sheets in 2019 = 48.17

Sales of Curtains in 2018 = 7.88

Sales of Curtains in 2019 = 12.21

Sales of Wall hangings in 2018 = 14.97

Sales of Wall hangings in 2019 = 29.14

**Calculation:**

Percentage of sales of Wall stickers increased from 2018 to 2019

⇒ [(10.19 - 5.01)/5.01] × 100 = 103.4%

Percentage of sales of Bed sheets increased from 2018 to 2019

⇒ [(48.17 - 20.15)/20.15] × 100 = 139%

Percentage of sales of Curtains increased from 2018 to 2019

⇒ [(12.21 - 7.88)/7.88] × 100 = 55%

Now we can say sales of Curtains have increased by nearly 55% from 2018 to 2019.

5x = 250

⇒ x = 250/5 = 50

⇒ 4x = 50 × 4 = 200

Export in 2016 were = Rs. 200 million

Let exports in 2017 be k, then

200 + k = 500

⇒ k = 500 - 200

⇒ k = 300 million

Export in 2017 were = Rs. 300 million

Ratio of import to export in 2017 = 1.4 = 14/10 = 7/5

Ratio of import to export in 2017 = 7y : 5y

According to the question 

5y = 300

⇒ y = 300/5

⇒ y = 60

7y = 60 × 7

⇒ 7y = 420 

∴ Import in 2017 were = Rs. 420 million

questions.question: If each edge of a cube is increased by 10%, then the percentage increase in its surface area is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Each edge of a cube is increased by 10%.

**Formula:**

If each edge of cube is increased by x%, then 

the percentage increase in its surface area = x + x + (x × x)/100

Total surface area of cube = 6a²

**Calculation:**

Let side of cube be 10 m

Total surface area of cube = 6 × 10² = 600 m²

New side of cube = 10 × (110/100) = 11 m

New total surface area of cube = 6 × 11² = 726 m²

Area increased by = 726 - 600 = 126 m²

∴ Area increased by (in %) = (126/600) × 100 = 21%

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

The percentage increase in its surface area = 10 + 10 + (10 × 10)/100

⇒ 20 + 1 = 21%

questions.question: A person marks his 40 items at 20% above the cost price. He sells 10 items at a 10% discount and 20 items at a 15% discount on the marked price. What is the maximum discount (rounded off) he can offer on the remaining items if he still gets some profit?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total number of items = 40

MP of the items is more than that of cost price is = 20%

The person sells 10 items at a discount = 10%

He sells 20 items at a discount = 15%

**Formula:**

Discount = MP – SP

Discount % = Discount/MP × 100 

**Calculation:**

Let cost price of each items be Rs. 1

Cost price of 40 items = 1 × 40 = Rs. 40

MP of 40 items = 40 × (120/100) = Rs. 48

Selling price of 10 items = 10 × (120/100) × (90/100) = Rs. 10.8

Selling price of 20 items = 20 × (120/100) × (85/100) = Rs. 20.4

MP of the remaining 10 items = 10 × 120/100 = Rs. 12

Net profit = (12 + 20.4 + 10.8) - Rs. 40 = 43.2 - 40 = Rs. 3.2

If he gives discount Rs. 3.2 on Rs. 12 he gets neither profit nor loss.

Required discount = 3.2/12 × 100 = 26.67%

Now we can say after giving 26% discount he still gets some profit.

questions.question: An oil merchant wants to make a minimum profit of Rs. 2,100 by selling 50 litres of oil he purchased at Rs. 236 per litre. questions.solution:

The oil merchant wants to make a minimum profit = Rs. 2100

50 litres of oil purchased = Rs. 236 per litre

Cost of duplicate oil = Rs. 180 per liter

Selling price of 1 liter oil = Rs. 250

**Calculation:**

Let quantity of duplicate oil added be x litres.

According to the question

50 × 236 + x × 180 + 2100 = (50 + x) × 250

⇒ 11800 + 180x + 2100 = 50 × 250 + 250x

⇒ 13900 - 12500 = 250x - 180x 

⇒ 70x = 1400

⇒ x = 1400/70

⇒ x = 20 

20 liters of duplicated oil mixed in mixture.

questions.question: A can finish a piece of work in a certain number of days. B takes 45% more number of days to finish the same work independently. They worked together for 58 days and then the remaining work was done by B alone in 29 days. In how many days could A have completed the work, had he worked alone?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

B takes 45% more number of days to finish the same work independently.

They worked together for 58 days and then the remaining work was done by B alone in 29 days.

**Formula:**

Total work = Efficiency × Time

**Calculation:**

Let number of days taken by A to complete the work be 100 days

Number of days taken by B to complete the work = 100 × (145/100) = 145

Time ratio of A to that of B = 100 : 145 = 20 : 29

Efficiency ratio of A to that of B = 29 : 20

Let efficiency of A = 29 unit/day

Efficiency of B = 20 unit/day

Work done by A and B in 58 days = (29 + 20) × 58 = 49 × 58 = 2842 unit

Remaining work which is done by B in 29 days = 20 × 29 = 580 unit

Total work = 2842 + 580 = 3422 unit

∴ Time taken by A to complete the whole work = 3422/29 = 118
